# vpnd commands

> **Status:** Current · **Type:** reference · **Tier:** —

<!-- Generated by `make docs-reference`. Edit the source, not this file. -->

`vpnd` is a convenience CLI in front of Make, Terraform, Ansible and SOPS;
it never replaces them. The parser in `vpnd/src/vpnd/cli.py` is the single
definition of flags and subcommands; the man pages and this page derive
from it. Installation and development notes: [`vpnd/README.md`](../../vpnd/README.md).

## Global options

| Option | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `-h, --help` | show this help message and exit |
| `--explain` | Print underlying invocations without running them. |
| `--yes, -y` | Skip settings confirmation; plan and dry-run reviews still prompt. |
| `--root` | Override repository root (VPN_DEPLOY_ROOT; default: discover from cwd). |
| `--env, -e` | Target environment (VPN_ENV; default: prod). |
| `--provider, -p` | Cloud provider Terraform root (VPN_PROVIDER; default: upcloud). |
| `--version, -V` | show program's version number and exit |

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vpnd deploy` | Interactive deploy wizard. |
| `vpnd reconverge` | Idempotent re-deploy against existing hosts. |
| `vpnd share` | Bundled recipient handoff (URL, QR, sing-box and app cards). |
| `vpnd doctor` | Diagnostic bundle. |
| `vpnd probe` | Profile-aware probing. |
| `vpnd probe-matrix` | Multi-protocol simultaneity DPI probe across a configured matrix. |
| `vpnd preflight` | Pre-deploy guards. |
| `vpnd fleet` | Fleet-wide operations. |
| `vpnd host` | Local host registry. |
| `vpnd ai-docs` | Machine-readable docs endpoints. |
| `vpnd update` | Check for a newer vpnd release (cached 24 h). |
| `vpnd completions` | Emit shell completions to stdout. |
